_about: GDL90 Traffic Report (0x14) conformance vectors for the Carbonix GDL90 encoder. Generated by running stratux/stratux's unmodified encoder across the field space, then substituting 4 vectors where Stratux departs from the GDL 90 ICD (560-1058-00 Rev A). Substituted entries carry 'superseded_stratux' and 'reason'. The other 75 are Stratux's bytes verbatim. 'expect' is authoritative: all vectors must match.

vectors.name: alt_-999
vectors.reason: Negative altitude: (alt+1000)/25 keeps the dividend non-negative so the result cannot depend on integer-division semantics. Stratux's (alt/25)+40 flips bias sign at 0 ft. Mean error is identical; ours is consistent.

vectors.name: speed_4095
vectors.reason: ICD 3.5.1.7 mandates holding at 0xFFE; 0xFFF is reserved for 'no horizontal velocity available'. Stratux masks to 12 bits with no clamp, so 4095 emits the no-data sentinel for a real velocity.

vectors.name: pos_44.90708_-122.99488
vectors.reason: ICD 3.5.2 worked example: the spec's own answer is A8 89 78. Stratux stores lat/lng as float32, whose mantissa step at ~5.7e6 is 0.5, so the quotient rounds across an integer boundary and truncation returns one LSB low.
